# Papa Beard (Cotton Candy Colt)

Papa Beard is the fan-name for the cotton-candy seller at Rainbow Dash’s first Wonderbolts show in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Gameloft subsequently called the same stallion **Cotton Candy Colt** in its *My Little Pony* mobile game—not a second pony or a secret identity.

**Appearance:** A pale aqua Earth pony with a fluffy pink mane and tail, an enormous curly pink moustache and beard, a striped vendor’s apron, and a cotton-candy-stick cutie mark. [G4 stallion character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions).

**Names and speaking:** “Papa Beard” is an unofficial background-pony label; **Cotton Candy Colt** is the name used in Gameloft’s licensed game, which describes him as “Happy to hand out sweet treats for any occasion.” The game added him in update 3.1 in 2016. No spoken dialogue or identifiable voice credit was verified for the television pony. [Gameloft character entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Cotton_Candy_Colt).

## Important moments

- **The increasingly gigantic order — “Newbie Dash” (S6E7, May 7, 2016):** While the Wonderbolts perform, Pinkie Pie keeps demanding “Bigger!” at his cotton-candy stand and holds up Spike; it is his one clearly documented television scene. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q3nh6bSauu0) (scene timestamp unavailable: the video is identified as the complete episode, but its exact scene time could not be checked). [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Newbie_Dash).

There are no verified additional character-defining scenes; later game appearances should not be mistaken for further television roles.
